text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since I became<n>Air Shakur's
trainer. We haven't had<n>any glaring issues, but I do
have one<n>concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Talk, huh... What about?
choice_data_list:
Um... Would you like to get food together after
training?

Um... Would you like to get food together after
training?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The two of us haven't gotten any<n>closer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even on a good day, Air Shakur's<n>attitude towards
me is prickly at best.<n>But I want to do everything I
can to<n>support her in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And for me to do that, she needs to<n>trust me.
Obviously it won't happen<n>all at once, but surely I
can build up<n>that trust little by little.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After asking around, I managed to<n>come up with a
few ideas to help us<n>get closer. All that's left is to
bring<n>them up to Air Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? An outdoor festival? No way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? You made your own PC? You?Huh... And?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's becoming clear that Air Shakur<n>doesn't want to
interact with me<n>outside training-related business.
choice_data_list: But I won't give up yet!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So now you want to spend the day<n>together, huh?
What's gotten into you<n>recently?
choice_data_list: I just want us to get to know each other better.
I just want us to get to know each other better.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not necessary. We only formed a<n>contract because
I needed a trainer<n>for my debut.
choice_data_list: But I'll let you pick the place!
But I'll let you pick the place!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have to talk. All I can<n>hope is that
this time together will<n>help her trust me just a little
more.<n>Once I explain my intentions to her...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have to talk. All I can<n>hope is that
this time together will<n>help her trust me just a little
more.<n>Once I explain my intentions to her...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All right, fine. Guess I'll just waste aday with this then... You said I couldpick the place, right?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I meet up with Air Shakur the<n>next day. She
then takes me to...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One with only single booths at that.<n>Our booths
aren't even next to each<n>other... But I did promise
she could<n>pick, and I won't go back on my<n>word.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But I also don't know when our next<n>outing will be,
if ever... So I have to<n>make this work!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What now? This better be good, or<n>I'm kicking you
out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm not hungry, nor do I think I<n>will be.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: C-can I at least get you something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Would you SHUT UP?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, if you really wanna be<n>friends or whatever,
give me. Some<n>damn. SPACE!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, miss, could we speak for<n>a moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: WHAT NOW?! ...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Guess I can't go back there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Lots of trainers have business-like<n>arrangements
with their trainees. And<n>it's not like their race
results suffer<n>from that lack of a personal
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're aware of that fact<n>too. So I can
think of only one reason<n>you'd keep up this
stupidity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You must believe that us being all<n>buddy-buddy
would be good for me.<n>Seeing the loner avoid
making friends<n>makes you sad, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Should've known better. Nothing<n>changes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only partner I need is my PC. So<n>quit inviting me
out. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur doesn't see the need to<n>build
relationships with people. I<n>understand that. After
all, she made it<n>this far on her own, with only her
numbers to guide her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: What will happen when sheencounters a problem she can'tsolve on her own? I want to preparefor that possibility.
choice_data_list: I won't give up that easy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As always, you make no sense.<n>Wouldn't it be
easier to just do as I<n>say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want.
